items.summary: CFO recommendation: freeze new monetization claims, forecasts, and finance-impacting admissions. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The $4.92 and 629 aggregate clicks are unattributed; therefore site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and forecast revenue are unsupported. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com request only as a capacity-gated, reversible experiment after one delivery slot is released and site overlap clears; do not treat clicks, sessions, impressions, proposals, or conversions as revenue.

AI spend is measurable only for 2026-10-01: $10.8396 across 85 calls and 11 instrumented sites, versus 38 expected sites; coverage is 28.9%. The calculable proxy is approximately $0.1275 per AI call, not cost-to-learn. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment outcomes, validated learning units, attributable revenue, and complete AI coverage are unavailable. Infrastructure, hosting, domains, labor, and other direct costs are absent, so contribution margin and budget exposure cannot be quantified. Minimum measurement needed: a dated fleet/site cost ledger covering AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, and other directly attributable costs, joined to site/content identifiers and the revenue window.

Retain the existing Amazon attribution boundary: report the 18 named tracking rows separately and preserve the 629 aggregate clicks and $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed. Do not assign aggregate earnings to any site or publish revenue, margin, ROI, payback, or causal-lift claims. The current $0 site-attributed commission for allthingsmasonic.com in the 2026-09-21 window supports testing a conversion path, not a revenue claim.
